definitionsText.visits: Each authenticated page navigation or refresh counts as a visit, including repeat visits by the same person. Resource usage measures visits to the corresponding page. Visits are recorded from the launch of this feature. The visit period also filters practice answers and homework and quiz submission counts.
definitionsText.assessments: Homework, lab and preparation quiz tabs show cumulative results for published assignments, independent of the visit period. Homework and labs must have started. Expected submissions use each assignment's current classroom roster. Completion is completed divided by expected submissions; a student counts once per assignment. Average scores and distributions include only completed assignments by current students. Incomplete work is not scored as zero.
definitionsText.labs: A lab report is complete when all four tasks have graded submissions. Saved records without all four submissions are in progress. Total scores match the teacher report, including operation points, answer scores and teacher corrections.
definitionsText.lessons: Only published preparation quizzes are included. Results are grouped by course section using the current classroom roster. Accuracy is correct answers divided by submitted answers. Response rate is submitted answers divided by expected answers. Missing submissions do not reduce accuracy. Repeated sections across quizzes are counted separately. A dash indicates that a rate cannot be calculated without answers or expected submissions.
